scene.head: tilt
scene.ofreeRecent: the paved square before a city gate tower — standing; a grand museum hall with marble statues at night — holds a freshly printed instant photo up to the light; the Zhuge Liang shrine on the Wuzhang Plains plateau — rests a red oil-paper umbrella open on her shoulder; a quiet city tram-stop platform at dawn — she is delightedly taking a first bite from a very large steamed breakfast bun before the tram arrives; a small outdoor carnival rehearsal yard with striped fabric pavilions — she is trying the padded seat of a miniature fairground ride; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — carries a camera by its grip at her side; a scholar's study stacked with bound bamboo slips — holds a magnifying glass by its handle at chest height; terraced tea fields on a misty Sichuan hillside — kneeling on the ground; the Wuhou Shrine in Chengdu — kneeling on the ground; a hydroponic bathing pool aboard a starship — chest-deep in the water; a neon-lit game arcade — takes a bite from a cloud of pink cotton candy on a stick; a floating sky garden of hanging vines and flowering terraces above the clouds — crouching low on her heels; an outdoor theatre of tiered seats facing a stage — hugs a striped tub of popcorn against her side

AGE: the same adult woman as in the attached image — keep her own face shape, cheekbones, eye proportions and skin tone exactly; minimal facial lines (no nasolabial folds, crow's feet, under-eye bags or cheek creases). OUTPUT: one standalone off-duty scene of her in the outfit chosen in SCENE; her legend shows only through accessories and objects around her — never in the outfit's colours, patterns or cut, never as armor, regalia or a costume. Everything else follows SCENE (chosen).

Place: A light-testing cabin in a civilian theater with cool overhead panels, a narrow mirror and a rack of translucent color swatches.
Activity: She sets a borrowed quilted shoulder bolero onto its hanger to compare a cobalt swatch with the opaque satin lounge outfit underneath.
Pose: Standing upright in a front three-quarter turn, she holds the swatch at chest height and steadies the hanger with her other hand.

Time of day (fixed): cool white overhead light, flat and bright — set your scene at this time.
Outfit: An opaque cobalt satin corsetry-inspired camisole with a curved neckline, silver bound seams and matching high-waisted lounge shorts.
overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: bold — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing; intimate areas covered

Do not carry the attached image's palette, patterns or trim into the outfit; her mecha-world identity belongs in accessories and props, never in the clothes — never restyle the chosen outfit into her faction's palette, armor, robes or regalia.

ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. No default card pose, no default front-facing portrait.

ONE MAIN FIGURE: she is the only character in focus. Where the place is busy, other people may appear only as small, soft-focus background extras — never posed with her. No logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border. No readable text or numbers.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, about 7.5 heads tall — height from the legs, never a smaller head or a longer neck. The neck is a natural length and the head sits close to the shoulders. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs.

FIGURE: keep her exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame. Right and left mean her own right and left, not the viewer's.

HANDS: natural human hands, no extra or duplicated limbs; each visible hand joins through its wrist and forearm to the matching shoulder. A hand may stay outside the crop, and fingers may be partly hidden by a grip.

AVOID: a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.
